coverages.flexibleHelp: Volunteers may give shifts away and take others over.

admin.draftNote: Draft: volunteers do not see this schedule until you publish it.
admin.endsAfterStart: A shift must end after it starts.

admin.handoverHelp: How a shift changes hands between volunteers.
